title.narrative: Innovation Space

description.narrative: Innovation space will promote and strengthen the innovation culture, especially among women and youth, and facilitates innovation supply and demand matchmaking. This will be done by engaging the local private sector, academia and the government to: (i) introduce digital culture to the wider Jordanian public; (ii) foster digital skills among women and youth; and (iii) nurture entrepreneurship by identifying key opportunities for increased digital economic growth, new markets, and investments.
